trajectory_summary: A short, low-friction call that ran the verify script competently until a manufactured-home disclosure at 02:22 went unrecognized as a hard gate. The rep only caught it after a hold-and-check, so four minutes were spent building an appointment that was never viable. Energy neither built nor leaked much — it simply ended on a gate the rep should have flagged live.
outcome_dispute: v1 tag is unknown; this call is correctly read as dq — the transcript shows the rep explicitly ending pursuit on the manufactured-home gate at 04:34-04:43.

bill_anchor_audit.reasoning: Bill amount ($100) was captured at 02:52 but the call moved straight to prior_design and then hold/DQ — the flip should have gone right after the bill answer, e.g. tying the low bill or the ad's promised savings back to a reason to look further, but nothing happened before the DQ ended pursuit.

bill_document_audit.reasoning: The rep did not request the customer's utility bill or ask for a photo/email of it during the call.

interest_reason_audit.reasoning: The customer's stated interest reason (the $30,000 solar incentive ad) was acknowledged once at 00:46 with 'Okay' but never reinforced or tied back to anything later in the call, which ended in DQ before any appointment-setting could use it.
